About Clarix Digitech

Building practical software for Indian school teams

Clarix Digitech Private Limited is a Pune-based B2B SaaS company started in 2026 by an engineering-led team focused on making school management simple, affordable, and paperless.

Company snapshot

  • Founded: 2026
  • Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India
  • Stage: Pre-revenue, product under development
  • Focus: B2B SaaS for private schools

Why we started

Schools deserve software that respects their budgets and routines

We identified a critical gap in how Indian private schools manage their daily operations. Too much time is spent on fee registers, attendance sheets, and manual follow-up.

Clarix exists to remove that friction with software that fits real school workflows instead of forcing schools into complicated enterprise systems.

Mission

Make school management simple, affordable, and paperless.

Team

Engineering-led and execution-focused

A small Pune-based team building a focused SaaS product for Indian education operations.

How we operate

Clarity, affordability, and local support

We are designing Clarix to be easy to adopt for non-technical school teams while staying credible for investors and long-term growth.

Built for India

Our product decisions are shaped by the needs of Indian private schools.

Affordable by design

We believe useful technology should fit school budgets, not stretch them.

Pune team stays accessible

Pune-based support keeps conversations direct during early access and rollout.
